Any individual can be pointed as a cyberbully if they engage in inappropriate and disrespectful behavior. Like bullies, cyberbullies are often people we know. Sometimes even people we consider close can turn to bullying for behavioural reasons.
Cyberbullies are just an online version of real life bullies who consider themselves to be superior to others and feel good about themselves by making others feel low.
Sometimes cyberbullies are not actually mean but cause hurt to others because they feel hurt themselves because of their own surroundings.
